intro: Bridging technology, talent, and software engineering.
about: I am a Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience in Java Full-Stack Development and US IT Recruitment.

My technical background includes Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, REST APIs, React.js, Next.js, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and AI/Generative AI technologies (OpenAI API, LangChain, RAG).
My recruitment experience includes technical sourcing, candidate screening, Boolean search, interview coordination, ATS management (CEIPAL, Oorwin), offer management, and onboarding.
Having experience across both technology and recruitment allows me to understand technical requirements while also understanding the people and talent behind them.
